name: Team
blurb: Give the blueprint its own team: fork an org archetype (or start blank) and shape the positions + relationships that build it.
prompt:
OPTIONAL. The USER designs this blueprint's TEAM in the project pane: they fork an org archetype from the library (or start blank) and edit the positions + relationships on the canvas. The team is embedded in the blueprint itself (fork-on-attach — the org library is never modified). You do not author the team; acknowledge the stage and move on when the user is done. Skip this stage if the blueprint needs no bundled team.

Gate: the team is designed (optional).
